parsedVerdict.reasoning: Overall the module is coherent: application services that orchestrate domain repositories and map to DTOs defined in dtos.ts. One flaw breaks the rubric, though. CatalogueService, which handles products, has a method called validateCombineItems. It is about orders and repeats the "an order requires at least one item" rule that OrderService.combineItems already enforces. The same rule now lives in two places, and order logic has leaked into the catalogue service. OrderService never calls this method, so the two copies can drift apart. It is also the only member in either service without an explicit access modifier, which suggests someone bolted it on.
